diff --git a/backlog/decisions/286-console-prompt-mix-ins.md b/backlog/decisions/286-console-prompt-mix-ins.md
index d2110ca0ff..75e0cb5f1e 100644
--- a/backlog/decisions/286-console-prompt-mix-ins.md
+++ b/backlog/decisions/286-console-prompt-mix-ins.md
@@ -227,3 +227,11 @@ The focused publication port targets dev `2acbcd42f3e7b07fd122f5f6dc6b22e7385f10
 ### Accepted usage facts (PR3346 review)
 
 Source capture and Preview only build provisional immutable snapshots. Accepted manual input publishes last-used revision at native acceptance (or ephemeral acceptance); queue input publishes these facts when custody admission succeeds. Current-choice Regenerate, Edit and Continue publish after their operational receipt is accepted. Original Retry and queue drain never refresh current-choice facts. Publication reads no source, skips unavailable preferences and never re-adds removed selections. Current-capture witnesses authorize accepted placement/order observations only while their captured preference revision remains current; a changed layout advances that revision and rejects stale Workbench intents. Workbench project/save retain name presentation and explicit layout CAS. Used-version-only facts do not advance the intent revision. Current received input commits its draft before publishing accepted layout; accepted execution no longer applies pre-acceptance input-currentness checks. Frozen Retry, queued drain and externally supplied configurations have no current-layout observation authority; queue current observations publish once at admission. A newer user intent wins over delayed layout publication. A placement already used by the accepted revision is not labeled updated since last send. Refused hooks, provider resolution and preparation preserve all choice facts.
+
+### Accepted operational identity during capture recovery
+
+An accepted native turn's validated durable commit owns its operational mix-in attempt and frozen snapshot. Choosing Send without capture after an optional trace failure may allocate a new diagnostic/provider admission identity, but it does not allocate a new operational mix-in attempt or recapture current choices. The accepted commit passes its original checkpoint attempt identity to the existing stream/receipt owner; repeated publication must verify the same immutable receipt and anchors. Trace opt-out does not relax checkpoint ownership, missing/corrupt marked-receipt refusal, or original Retry authority. Diagnostic capture remains optional and independent of this mandatory operational record.
+
+## CI integration clarification: model and storage dependencies
+
+The existing immutable operational values and strict JSON compatibility codecs belong in `Chat/console_prompt_mixin_models.py`. Request composition and selection reconciliation stay in the domain module; its existing public imports remain available. Shared literal-v3 envelope/definition validation and size limits use the pure artifact-model owner. Coherent DB snapshot reads retain strict validation inside their existing transaction, without importing the general artifact compiler/service. This is a source dependency correction, with unchanged persisted JSON, receipt identity, format classifications and source-authority contracts; no migration is introduced.
